title: Saving 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1's DNS cache
author: TangerineDream
aiHeadline: In a move that will shock no one, 1.1.1.1's DNS cache has been optimized to save 100 terabytes of memory, proving once again that even the internet needs to clean up its act and stop being so wasteful with storage space.

title: Microduck
author: robotswantdata
aiHeadline: Introducing Microduck: the world's tiniest robotic duck, because clearly the world needed another tiny robot to remind us that we're living in a dystopian future where even our pets are being miniaturized for no apparent reason.

title: Small Models Have Arrived
author: tosh
aiHeadline: Small models have arrived, and they're here to remind us that not everything needs to be the size of a supercomputer. Finally, AI has realized that sometimes less is more, or at least less is manageable on a regular laptop.

title: 507 Mechanical Movements
author: helloplanets
aiHeadline: 507 Mechanical Movements: because clearly the world needed a catalog of every possible way a machine can move, just in case you ever wanted to know how to make a lever do a backflip or a pulley system perform interpretive dance.

title: Trade (and Tariffs)
author: throw0101d
aiHeadline: Trade (and Tariffs): because nothing says 'I love you' like a well-placed tariff, and if you don't think that's romantic, then you've clearly never been in a long-distance relationship with a country.
